name: hotfix_2026_11_25_part2
objective: Full notes: official Blizzard hotfix post, linked in the description.
pages: The Altar of the Deeps can be used again after 3 seconds and correctly gives the Blessing of Blackfathom.
The Avatar of Hakkar no longer fails to spawn.
Centaurs in Magram Village respawn more quickly.
No longer sometimes spawns inside a tree.
Clubtoe in Sunnyglade no longer flags you for PvP.
Now sells to vendors for more than 2 copper.
Now called Totem of the Maelstrom.
Its haste buff now works correctly and only affects the person wielding it.
This trinket can no longer be resisted.
Usable again while mounted or casting. It broke as a side effect of a different bug fix.
They stopped giving credit once you reached Exalted. Now they keep counting.
Finishing this quest should now give Legacy credit.
Now really cuts durability loss by 8, 16, 24, 32 or 40%. It did not work as stated before.
Now makes Shadowform, Moonkin Form, Travel Form and Trueshot Aura free, as intended.
